description: Verify that the original module file no longer exists or has been renamed, and that two new module files are present.
command: test ! -f original_module.py && test -f module_a.py && test -f module_b.py

description: Ensure that the total number of public functions/classes in the two new modules matches the count in the original module.
command: python -c "import ast, sys; f1=ast.parse(open('module_a.py').read()); f2=ast.parse(open('module_b.py').read()); c1=len([n for n in ast.walk(f1) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))]); c2=len([n for n in ast.walk(f2) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))]); assert c1 + c2 == 10, f'Count mismatch: {c1}+{c2} != 10'"

description: Run the existing test suite to confirm no behavioral changes.
Verify that no circular imports exist between the two new modules.
command: python -c "import module_a, module_b; print('No circular imports detected')"
